description: Create or update an item's sourcing profile (its default price book + production spec). Matching: with name, the item's profile of that name is updated (or created); without name, the item's single existing profile is updated — ambiguous or first-time cases require name. The item's owner is derived server-side; a book attributed to a different client is refused; the spec is validated against the book's schema (invalid specs are refused, never priced). Set preview=true for the governed two-step protocol (a validated would-be profile plus a single-use previewReceipt); repeat with that receipt and a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

bookId.description: The default price book id (GUID) for this edition.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

isDefault.description: Make this the item's default profile. Omitted = preserve current state.

itemSku.description: The item SKU this profile belongs to.

name.description: Edition label (e.g. "Hardback"). Optional when updating an item's only profile; required to create.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive the would-be profile plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

spec.description: Cost-driver attribute values keyed by the book's schema, e.g. {"trim": "6x9"}.

name: upsert_item_sourcing_profile
title: Upsert Item Sourcing Profile
